sentences.text: Shri Satish Yadav, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri Gaurav Singh Chouhan, learned Govt. Advocate for t  respondent/State.

Heard on IA No.3019/2023, which is third application filed under Section 389 (1) of Cr.P.C., for temporary suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of the appellant "
Mannalal S/o Bhagirath Kumawat.
The appellant is convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376 (AB) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 20 years rigorous imprisonment and fine of 5,000/-, with default stipulation and under Section 342 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo three months rigorous imprisonment.
This is third application for temporary suspension of sentence of the appellant on the ground of his medical condition.

The documents filed by the appellants have also been verified by the respondent/State and have been found to be true and it is also mentioned in the report that due to lack of Police force the appellant could not be taken to the hospital.
In such circumstances, we deem it fit to allow the present application for a period of one month from the date of his release.

Execution of jail sentence of the appellant is hereby temporarily suspended for a period of one month from the date of his release and it is ordered that the appellant Mannalal S/o Bhagirath Kumawat be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

The appellant shall surrender before the trial court on the very next day upon completion of the period of one month, failing which the trial Court shall be free to take appropriate action for taking him into custody.
